better.instructions: `first` and `second` are passages of two novels, of some 3,000 words each. Which of the two is the better written?

lesson.instructions: `first` and `second` are passages of two novels, of some 3,000 words each. Which of the two would a teacher of writing rather give to a class as an example to learn from?

enjoy.instructions: `first` and `second` are passages of two novels, of some 3,000 words each. Which of the two would most readers enjoy reading more?

remarks: Variant: compare. Passages of two books side by side, both ways round: which is better written, which a teacher would take, which readers would enjoy.
